meta.name: plan
meta.description: Sequence an understood outcome into verifiable delivery slices with dependencies, ownership and acceptance checks. Use for delivery planning, estimation or migration strategy.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把想清楚的目标拆成可验收的交付步骤,标明依赖、负责人与验收标准
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果目标已经明确,却说不清先做哪一步、谁来负责、怎样算完成。
copy.tagline_en: Break a clear goal into verifiable delivery steps with dependencies, owners and acceptance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if the goal is clear but you can't yet tell what comes first or who owns it.

howto.what: 把已理清的目标拆成可验证的交付切片,标注依赖、负责人和验收检查,产出交付计划、估算或迁移策略。
howto.when: 当你要求做交付规划、估算或迁移策略时接管;若由 @fde 调用,则复用其现有范围,不重走发现或提问流程。

say.text: 把这个目标拆成带依赖和验收标准的交付切片
say.note: 产出带依赖与验收检查的分片计划

say.text: 帮我估算这次迁移的工期和负责人分工
say.note: 按可验证切片给出估算与归属

say.text: 按现有上下文做交付计划,别再重新问一遍
say.note: 复用已给范围,不重走发现

howto.what_en: Turns an understood outcome into verifiable delivery slices with dependencies, ownership and acceptance checks, producing a delivery plan, estimate or migration strategy.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you ask for delivery planning, estimation or migration strategy. When invoked by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting discovery.

say_en.text: Slice this outcome into delivery pieces with dependencies and acceptance checks
say_en.note: Returns a sliced plan with dependencies

say_en.text: Estimate the effort and ownership for this migration
Build the delivery plan from the context we already gave
say_en.note: Reuses existing scope, no new discovery
